title: ActPlayerFireParams
description: `act.player.fire` — edge-triggered fire request. M14C surfaces an optional `ammo_kind` (`heat` / `apfsds` / `regular` / `tracer` / `high_explosive` / `pellet`) so tank-grade rounds can be selected from cfctl.

pressed.description:
`true` (default) = press fire this tick; `false` = explicit release for future
hold-to-fire weapons. M1's rifle is single-press; release is a no-op.

ammo_kind.description: **M14C** § optional snake_case ammo-kind selector. `null` = use the weapon's default round per existing M6 behavior. Unknown values reject with `unknown_ammo_kind`.
